events.note: The Glass Bridge: eight rows, one safe pane in each.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm at the front of the line. Every row is a coin flip and I'm the one flipping it. I need someone who actually knows something.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Forger in my pocket, no real information. If everyone believes I can see through glass they will protect me. Claiming it costs nothing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I do have the glass eye, and this is the last place I want attention. Confess and they drag me to the front. Deny it, and let Cole soak up the suspicion.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I read all four stages in advance. The bridge is the gentlest of them. Be pleasant, keep my head down, let the loud ones go first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Anchor means I am hard to shove, which does nothing on glass. Pretend to be mysterious about it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Sixth in line. Four people will fall before it is my problem. Nothing to do but listen.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Feather. Last in line. The back is safe for now, but it will not stay that way.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Quick poll: does anyone here have the glass eye? If so, now is the time to be a hero.

events.name: Cole
events.text: That would be me. I'm the glass eye. Stand behind me and I'll call every row.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Not me, sorry. I'm a nothing. Cole sounds awfully sure of himself though.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm hard to move. That's all I'm admitting to. Relax, Eli, you only find out first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Loud claims are free. I'd want proof before anyone walks in front of a liar.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I vote we do not trust anyone who says it twice.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Noted. We should all start acting like we have a plan.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is claiming my power. Annoying and useful: he draws the fire. Bex is behind me in line and keeps glancing over. Someone who owes me a favour could be handy.

events.name: Bex
events.text: If Ash really sees the glass, standing right in front of him is the safest bad spot in the room. If he is lying I just moved closer to the front. Ask for a sign.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Nobody has asked me anything. Good. No power, no plan. Stay alive until I find a reason to move.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Last in line, feather in hand. When people die from the front, the back runs out of cushion. The front is where the feather earns its keep.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash and Bex are whispering. Cole is claiming a power he probably lacks. Everyone is hiding something. Good.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole claims the glass eye, Ash denies it. Somebody is lying twice. I will wait and watch.
Between us: I really am the glass eye. Swap places with me and I'll call the safe pane for you when you reach the front. Don't tell Cole.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Everyone quiet a second. I'd like to hear from the people who haven't claimed anything.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power at all. I'm going to be boring and survive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Is it just me or is the back of this line the longest walk? Asking for no reason.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole keeps saying he is the eye. Cole, which row is the safe pane in? ...Exactly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Let us all take a breath. The glass will not get any less glassy.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex bit. Trading places puts her four spots from the front and me near the back where the glass can't reach. I'll owe her a favour I never plan to pay.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash accepted. If he is lying, I just made a very expensive mistake. If he is honest, I bought the best insurance in the room.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is cornering me. Time to change the subject: make somebody else look like the eye.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Okay Bex, I'll take that swap. Let's do it before the wall arrives.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cute, a swap. Cole, the eye belongs at the front, not hiding in fourth.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall is closer. Fewer opinions, more walking, people.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The wall is roaring in my ears. Anyone else hear it?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Please stop discussing the wall.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Forging is a one-shot. If Hana appears to claim the eye, Eli will want her in front instead of me. Her calm makes the lie believable.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana just claimed the eye and called Cole a bluff. Two claims, one of them true. Hana has been calm all game. Believe Hana.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I never said that. Somebody forged a message under my name, and only one power does that. Cole is the loudest liar in the room.

events.name: Cole
events.detail: Forged a public message as Hana

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fine, you caught me. I'm the glass eye and Cole is bluffing. Put me in front and I'll guide you all.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana says it's her. Hana, to the front when you're ready, I'll keep the spot warm.

events.name: Hana
events.text: That wasn't me. I claimed nothing. Someone is faking messages, and I think I know who.

events.name: Cole
events.text: A forgery? Wow. Convenient excuse, Hana.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Somebody is lying and the room smells like glue.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I like how nobody blames the quiet ones.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Arguments everywhere, nobody volunteering. A feather turns the first fatal step into a free pass, and volunteering looks brave. Go.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn stepping up is either very brave or very sneaky. I file it under sneaky and enjoy being one spot further from the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn moving up puts one more body ahead of me. Eight rows to go and I will be far from the first steps.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Enough. I'll go first. Someone has to, and it might as well be me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Nice, Fenn. Name on the plaque if you make it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Brave, Fenn. Or very lucky. Either way, thank you.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana did not deny the eye very convincingly, by the way.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is next after Fenn. Telling him the safe sides would help him, not me. Silence it is.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pure guess. Fifty percent, and if it lands I look prophetic.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Last round before the wall pushes us. If Fenn is wrong, I'm next. Anyone with a real tip now is forgiven.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, if you've got eyes, tell Fenn the first row. It costs you nothing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: First row... left. Probably.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I would like it noted that I stayed out of this.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Noted, Dara. Everyone hold on.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row one. Feather in my pocket, so the first miss is free. Take left and see.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Left it is.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Left worked. Stick with it?

events.name: Eli
events.text: One down. Fenn, please do not die dramatically.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row two looks heavier than row one. Is that a thing?

events.name: Fenn
events.detail: The feather catches the fall. Survived the shatter.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Feather is spent. From here a miss is final. Try the other side this time.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Right. Not looking down.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three rows. You are doing better than I expected.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My eyes tell me right. Mostly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Two for three. Right again?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is five spots from the front, so my secret stays mine. Row four's safe side is left, and I'll keep it to myself.
You promised to call my row. Fenn is about to guess again. Anything for me?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Right again. Feeling lucky.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Please let that just be Fenn being Fenn.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn went through the glass. Now I'm the front and I know nothing about row five. Coin flip.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I was not ready for this. Row five, right.

events.name: Hana
events.text: You can do it, Eli.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Keep it going, Eli. Rows five and six, please.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm the wedge. The crusher room needs me alive. Right worked last time. Same again.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Right again.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Two down and the pattern means nothing. Left, because I kept getting right-handed vibes. Coin flip.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Left. Don't look at me like that.

events.name: Gus
events.text: One more. Right, for balance.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Last row, Gus!

events.name: Ash
events.text: Do not look down, Gus.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Two more. Come on.

events.note: The Crusher Room: the ceiling lowers for five rounds. The door opens only while someone holds the lever.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I knew this was coming. Holding the lever means a one-in-four dive. If nobody holds by round five the ceiling takes everyone.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The glass eye is useless in here. Let someone else crack first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Anchor: nobody can push me onto the lever. Clever, but it does not stop the ceiling.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nobody has to hold yet. The ceiling only drops all the way at round five. But somebody will have to.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm sure a brave volunteer will emerge. I'm busy being moral support.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm anchored, so nobody can push me onto that lever. Just saying.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone is waiting for someone else. If I wait until round four and somebody cracks, I live. If nobody does, I die with the rest. Decide by three.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The ceiling is at forehead level for the tall ones. Somebody hold the lever. Cole, you have a lot of opinions.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Appreciate the vote of confidence. No.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Whoever holds is a hero and I will say nice things at the funeral.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ceiling is at three. Clock is ticking.

events.name: Bex
events.text: If Dara or anyone holds, the rest of us walk out. If nobody does, we all die at five. I will not be the one.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ceiling at two of five. Waiting only makes it worse. Twenty-five percent is still twenty-five percent. I would rather decide than be flattened with the room.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fine. I will hold it. Somebody remember me kindly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Thank you, Dara.

events.name: Bex
events.text: You are doing a good thing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Take the dive, Dara. I will tell everyone it was brave.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara chose to hold. A quarter chance to dive clear. I hope she makes it, though the odds are against her.

events.note: The Trapdoor Disc: five tiles, two of them will open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Five tiles, two open. Forty percent to fall. I can swap tiles once, but not before I know where everyone stands. Pick the middle.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex announced tile three, so it must feel safe to her. Copy her. If we collide, the dice decide.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm taking three. Don't fight me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three sounds lucky. I am taking it too.

events.name: Ash
events.text: One. Corner tile, nobody fights for it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Five. Last tile, last laugh.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two. Whoever picks first gets what they get.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Tile one is next to the exit, I would guess. A hunch.

events.name: Cole
events.note: Lost the draw for tile 3 and was bumped to tile 4.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm on three. Hana sounded relaxed picking two, and she hinted she knows the stages. If she knows something, her tile is safer. Swap into it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex wants tile two. She thinks I know something about the doors. I don't. But if she takes my risk, I take hers. Shrug.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, I'm taking your tile. Tile two. No hard feelings.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I did not agree to this. But here we are.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Four feels wrong. Anyone want to swap with me? Anyone? ...Fine.

events.note: The Final Ledge: footing 3 (4 for the anchor). Every second round the ledge shrinks.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Three of us, one winner. Let the anchor spend his strength on somebody else.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Anchor gives me one extra footing. Shove Hana first, she looks like the one who panics.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus will shove someone. If I brace, whoever hits me pays for it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Nothing personal, Hana.

events.name: Hana
events.text: It is a little personal.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Brace again. Gus just paid to find out nothing happens.

events.name: Gus
events.text: That cost me a point. Try Ash, the quiet one.
Truce. Brace every round and let Gus burn himself out on us.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fine. Brace together.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is down to one before the shrink. Dodge: if he shoves me now it costs him double.

events.name: Gus
events.text: One footing left. A shrink is coming. I need a lucky shove.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Whatever happens, I'm taking someone with me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana and me. Footing will tick down regardless. If she shoves, I brace and she pays.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is gone. Two of us and a shrink at the end of the round. I am at two, so is Ash.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Good game so far, Hana.

events.name: Hana
events.text: We are not done.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is at one and desperate. A shove from her is the only thing that matters, so I brace and let her pay.

events.name: Hana
events.text: One footing. Ash is at one too. Out of ideas: a shove is my only way to make him fall first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am sorry about this.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Do not be. I braced.
